reason: We need new customers in the new country next year, so I see why this exists. But I would not sign anything this month: my partner has to approve it, and I do not yet trust an outside firm to send cold emails under our name.
objection: Cold outreach going out under our name could annoy the people we want to sell to, or land us in GDPR trouble in a market we do not know yet. If that happens, it is our reputation that suffers, not the agency's.
would_change_my_mind: Speaking with a past client in wholesale or distribution who used it in another CEE country, and seeing in writing exactly who checks the GDPR side and that I approve every message before it goes out, so I can show my partner it is safe.
